text.tspan: aurora_cli — Command-line interface that discovers Aurora model
homes, validates mission-scoped models, renders Markdown + SVG views,
aurora_shared — Shared domain library that implements model
discovery, parsing, validation, rendering, and compact export
Rendered Markdown Documentation — Per-card Markdown files and mission

Rendered View Diagrams — Canonical view outputs emitted under Views/:

Compact Agent Export — Single-file compact model export emitted
as AGENT-<MISSION_ID>.jsjson (default location: model home root).
Model Discovery and Loading — Ability to locate Aurora model homes
from a user-provided path and load all card JSON/JSJSON files into
Model Validation — Ability to validate Aurora model invariants
and provide actionable diagnostics before any downstream
Markdown Rendering — Ability to render human-readable Markdown
documentation for every card plus a mission-level executive summary.
View Rendering — Ability to render canonical Aurora views by
generating DOT sources and producing SVG diagrams using a
Compact Agent Export — Ability to write a compact, single-file
snapshot of a mission-scoped model for agent consumption.
Audit Version Bumping — Ability to update card audit trail
versions (patch/minor/major) and append an audit event in a
Registry Backed Tooling — Ability to validate and render
using embedded canonical registries for card definitions,
CLI Command Runner — CLI entrypoint and command dispatcher
rendering, and compact export workflows and reports diagnostics
Model Discovery and Loading — Discovery and parsing layer that
locates model homes (schema-based), loads card files

Validation Engine — Validator that checks structural
invariants (duplicate ids, mission presence, link targets,
reachability) plus policy checks (secret asset ownership) and
Rendering Engine — Renderer that produces per-card Markdown
documentation, executive summaries, canonical view DOT sources, and
themed SVG diagrams; also writes compact agent exports.
Embedded Registries — Compile-time canonical registries for
rules), and view definitions (canonical view set) used by
Repository File System — Filesystem-backed store that holds

Render Card Markdown — Render per-card Markdown documentation
plus a mission executive summary into a chosen output directory.
Render View Diagrams — Render canonical Aurora views by writing DOT

Render All Artifacts — Render both card Markdown and view

Write Compact Export — Write a compact, single-file mission
Bump Audit Versions — Bump model audit trail versions

Discover and Load Models — Discover model homes from an input path

Embedded Canonical Registries — Provide embedded registries
